rows.grounds: compound denoting extent from the axle up to the top; internal sandhi preserved in the fused form
compound measure: sārdha (with a half) + veda (four) + aṅgula (finger-breadth)

items.question: What vertical height from axle to top is prescribed for this component?
premises: The prescribed extent runs from the axle to the top.
The specified measure is four and a half finger-breadths.
This measure is stated as the required dimension.
items.inference: Therefore the component's height from the axle to the top must be four and a half finger-breadths.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referent of the measured component is carried over from the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: And the height from the axle to the top should be four and a half finger-breadths.
